about: A personal approach to hair on John Marr Drive in Annandale. Customers praise the friendly consultations, attention to detail, and haircuts shaped around what they want.

reviews.author: T S
reviews.text: I’ve been going to An’Lei Hair Salon for nearly 2 years now and can confidently say this is my go-to hair stylist.

reviews.author: Hamid S.
reviews.text: He cut my hair exactly the same way as the picture I showed him, which is exactly what I wanted. The haircut was also very fast but still detailed and clean.
